name: General Sheet Metal Works Inc
old_description: After 110 years in business, General Sheet Metal Works is closing! Thank you for all of your support over the years!
about:
Founded in 1916, General Sheet Metal Works operated in Bridgeport, Connecticut for 110 years before announcing its closure in 2026. The company did not publicly disclose its founders or ownership structure in the available sources.

The shop specialized in custom metal fabrication, working with materials such as steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. No details on facility size, headcount, production volumes, or specific part numbers were provided in the source material.

The company did not list specific industry sectors or named customers in its public information. It described its services broadly as custom metal fabrication for industrial clients.

No stated differentiators, founding mission, or unique value propositions were disclosed in the available sources.
